title: Your First Switch Config
description: Configure the switch hostname to SW1 and verify your work.
scenario: Configure the switch hostname to SW1 and verify your work.

objectives.text: Enter privileged EXEC mode with enable

concepts.title: CLI Modes
concepts.body: A Cisco switch has modes. User EXEC (>) is read-only. Privileged EXEC (#) unlocks powerful commands. Global config (config)# lets you change the device.
concepts.code:
Switch> enable
Switch# configure terminal
Switch(config)#

concepts.title: The ? Help System
concepts.body: Type ? at any prompt to see available commands. Type a partial command + ? to see valid options.

concepts.title: Tab Completion
concepts.body: Type the first letters and press Tab. The switch fills in the rest. "conf t" is short for "configure terminal".

concepts.title: Saving Your Work
concepts.body: Changes live in RAM (running-config). Save with "write memory" so they survive a reboot.
